title: Weak continuity of Jacobian minors under uniform convergence with bounded Lipschitz constants (supplied step 6(v))
statement: Let m, p, r ∈ ℕ, L ≥ 0, and let v_j, v₀ : ℝ^m → ℝ^p (j ∈ ℕ) be L-Lipschitz maps with v_j → v₀ uniformly on ℝ^m. Let a : Fin r → Fin p (rows) and b : Fin r → Fin m (columns), and let c ∈ L¹(ℝ^m) (Lebesgue). For a map v put M^{a,b}(v)(u) := det((Dv(u)e_{b(t)})_{a(s)})_{s,t ∈ Fin r}, where Dv(u) := fderiv ℝ v u (the zero map where v is not differentiable) and e_t is the standard basis of ℝ^m. Then ∫ c·M^{a,b}(v_j) dλ → ∫ c·M^{a,b}(v₀) dλ as j → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (m p r : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (v : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid p) (v₀ : Euclid m → Euclid p) (a : Fin r → Fin p) (b : Fin r → Fin m) (c : Euclid m → ℝ), (∀ j, LipschitzWith L (v j)) → LipschitzWith L v₀ → TendstoUniformly v v₀ atTop → Integrable c → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ u, c u * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun s t => fderiv ℝ (v j) u (EuclideanSpace.single (b t) 1) (a s))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ u, c u * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun s t => fderiv ℝ v₀ u (EuclideanSpace.single (b t) 1) (a s))))
